text:
Mira: kicking off Velocity POC for Prospect. Target: sustained 150 qps gen with controlled microbursts up to 2k qps for 20s. Need runbook, cost estimate, and answers on BYOK/KMS. @Priya to own load plan. @Max infra lead.
Priya: quick clarifying q's — avg prompt tokens? typical generation length? embedding mix? customer wants payloads redacted before we upload?
Mira: prompt ~250–350 tokens, gen ~180–220 tokens. embeddings ~3–7% of requests. yes, redact PII before we share test set.
Jorge: security needs BYOK + TLS1.3 enforced. Also they'll ask for SOC2 doc and an encrypted transfer flow (SFTP or signed upload).
Max: infra note: to get reliable 2k spikes we should prewarm prefix cache and reserve burst capacity. Hosted can handle but transient cost for spikes will be nontrivial. Dedicated recommended for predictable billing if they want sustained bursts across business hours.
Priya: Draft runbook:
1) create test cluster with BYOK key
2) smoke test 30 qps
3) concurrency sweep (30 → 250)
4) sustained phase (150 qps, 30m)
5) burst rehearsals (20s & 60s) at 2k qps
6) collect p50/p95/p99 latencies, error rates, GPU util, token burn
Sample command:
```bash
rbx-load --target 150 --spike 2000 --spike-dur 20 --model redwood-13b-q4_0 --concurrency 110 --prewarm 600
```
Add header `x-customer-id:vel-vel` and mark payloads as REDACTED.
Max: infra checklist: attach KMS alias `cust/vel/byok` to cluster, set prewarm=10m, enable autoscale headroom, and create dashboards for p99/5xx/kvcache.
deploy-bot: cluster provisioned: id=vel-poc-07, nodes=8 (g5.xlarge equiv), endpoint=vel-poc-07.redwood.internal:443
Priya: minimal redacted payload for team:
{"prompt":"Summarize invoice #REDACTED","max_tokens":200}
Mira: security questionnaire due Fri — who will fill? Priya can own questionnaire; Jorge will provide redacted samples via SFTP.
Jorge: will send SFTP creds + encrypted tarball by EOD. also will request HSM-backed key for Dedicated evaluation.
Max: smoke run results on vel-poc-07:
- 50 qps: p95 120ms, p99 350ms
- 150 qps sustained: p95 210ms, p99 920ms
- 2k qps 20s spike: majority under 1.8s, a handful of 5xx at spike onset when KV caches cold. with prewarm & client retries, 5xx eliminated.
Attached: CSV with aggregated metrics (cpu/gpu/util, lat percentiles, errors)
Mira: good signal. Priya — please post final runbook + cost workbook by Mon EOD. Include Hosted vs Dedicated SLA tradeoffs and estimated burn for spike rehearsals.
Priya: will upload runbook + cost sheet to internal drive: https://rbx/internal/drive/vel-poc-runbook and share redacted copy for customer link after approvals. :rocket:
Max: scheduling rehearsal Tue 9am PT. Eng-SRE please stand by.
Eng-SRE: on call Tue 9am PT. We'll watch error rates and token burn. :eyes:
Jorge: customer preferred demo Thu 11am PT — can we confirm after Tue rehearsal?
Mira: locking Thu 11am PT pending rehearsal. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
